body: Galle Face Green, a historic urban park along the Indian Ocean in Colombo, Sri Lanka, is a must-visit for anyone looking to experience the city’s charm. Spanning over 12 acres, this seafront promenade offers a perfect blend of relaxation, history, and vibrant local culture.The wide open space is ideal for a leisurely stroll or for families and friends to gather, fly kites, or simply enjoy the ocean breeze. The sunset view from Galle Face Green is breathtaking, making it a popular spot for both locals and tourists to unwind in the evenings. The sight of the waves crashing against the shore as the sky turns into hues of orange and pink is simply mesmerizing.Food stalls line the promenade, offering a range of Sri Lankan street food, from spicy isso wade (prawn fritters) to refreshing coconuts. It’s the perfect way to taste authentic flavors while watching life unfold at the bustling seafront.However, it can get quite crowded, especially during weekends, and finding a peaceful spot might be challenging. The cleanliness can vary, but the atmosphere is generally lively and welcoming.In conclusion, Galle Face Green is more than just a park—it’s a cultural landmark that captures the essence of Colombo. Whether you’re there for a quiet walk or to enjoy some street food, it offers a relaxing escape with a dash of local flavor.

body: As you walk along the Green, the salty breeze carries the sounds of laughter and the rhythmic lapping of waves against the shore. The horizon is a canvas painted with the vibrant hues of sunset, casting a golden glow over the entire area. Families, friends, and couples are seen strolling, flying kites, or simply sitting on the grass, soaking in the picturesque surroundings.The charm of Galle Face Green is not just in its scenic beauty but also in the cultural tapestry it displays. Street vendors line the walkway, offering an array of local delicacies that are as much a feast for the senses as the view. The aroma of freshly fried isso wade (shrimp fritters) mingles with the sweet scent of tropical fruits, inviting you to indulge in the flavors of the island.Children run about with abandon, their joyful shrieks mingling with the sound of the ocean, while couples sit hand-in-hand, whispering sweet nothings as the sky transitions from blue to shades of pink and purple. The beach is a mosaic of life, each group adding its unique color to the vibrant tableau.As night falls, the Green takes on a different persona. The setting sun gives way to a blanket of stars, and the string lights from the nearby street food stalls cast a warm, inviting glow. The sound of music drifts through the air, a gentle melody that complements the rhythmic waves. It's a place where time seems to slow down, allowing you to savor every moment.Galle Face Green is more than just a beach; it's a cultural hub, a place of relaxation, and a window into the soul of Colombo. It's where memories are made, whether it's the joy of tasting a spicy snack for the first time or the peace of watching a magnificent sunset. Each visit leaves an imprint on your heart, a lovely reminder of the beauty of Sri Lanka and the serenity that can be found in the simplest of pleasures.

body: Galle Face Park and Beach isn't what one really thinks of as a park, nor a beach. It's more of a raised strip of land along the water with a high wall to protect it from the sea. It's not really a place one would go to swim or lay on the sand, and the park area grass is scarce and more a large dirt area. There are a few vendors selling wares, but overall there isn't much to do and it's not very nice. If you stop here, go for a quick stroll down the sidewalk near the shore and maybe walk out onto the Galle Face Observation Deck (a very short pier) to take a photo.
title: Galle Face Not So Green

body: Place a tourist will never miss. Its crowded usually during weekends with people coming to an evening of leisure watching the sunset as it is the west coast, and enjoying the sea breeze. Its a vast open space with many top hotels around it. The old parliament building and the emerging port city gives much to sightseeing.It has a walkway from one end to the other at light house of 3 to 4 kms.
title: Galle Face Green

body: Having had dinner at the Galle Face Hotel, we thought we'd go for a stroll along the green and find out what all the fuss was about (I've read a number of reviews). It was, in a word, terrible. There were a few very ordinary looking food outlets (much better street food is available elsewhere) and hundreds of people. Lots and lots of children running and playing (I was literally knocked over a couple of times). With no specific area zoned for the kids to enjoy themselves it really is like going for a walk in a school playground. There was (and always is) a nice breeze coming in from the ocean and the crash of the waves is always a lovely sound - I can think of better places to enjoy the evening ocean. By all means take a look, perhaps during the day, the 'green is quite a landmark and its fun to watch the myriad of kites flying as the sun sets. Just don't hang around for the night time attractions.
title: Just don't!

body: On our last few days in Colombo, we visited the "green" great place to see the sunset and watch locals. It's a big open area where you can kick a ball or fly a kite, but no shade! Most people go in the evening around and after sunset. No entry fee. Promenade by the water with street food shacks, tents and vendors. Feeling adventurous, we started with salty chillie mango. I didn't mind it but have never seen my wife's expression before😂. We had an assortment of prawn Pattie things which they fry in boiling oil in front of you. Topped with chopped onions and sauce (we asked for spicy)They were really tasty and delicious and edible, prawn heads and all. Cheap too, like 3 for 100 rupees with some variation. Also had chick peas with spicy sauce which were very nice. Many locals and others dipping feet in the water with life guard on duty. I think may have never been to the sea before. No I'll effects to report, so thumbs up from us🙏👍👍👍👍👍👍

body: Wandered down to this seafront strip after a visit to the Bahria Lake area. We bought one with some hot sauce just to get a taste of what we would expect in the evening.Unfortunately they had been in the hot sun all day and my wife reacted later with bad sickness.This is not a review to put you off coming here as we spoke to other guests who had been and loved it.Please make your own mind up.

body: If you are in Colombo, you simply cannot miss this place. It's right in the center of the city and provides a great contrast between silent ocean and bustling city life. You can also see kids flying kites here. There is a boundary wall to the sea where you can sit with popcorn in your hand and enjoy the view and cold breeze.
title: A must visit place, preferably in the evening.

body: This is one of the popular urban park in the heart of Colombo. It's a 12 acre land area stretches along the beach that gives the magnificent view of the Indian ocean. However, I avoid day time since not a fan of getting burnt and tanned by mid day sun. Early morning and night are the best time to enjoy the cool breeze. But place is crowded at night time and weekends are the busiest. There are plenty of food stalls to try out some Sri Lankan street foods. No idea how hygiene and have only tried them few times. Kids won't avoid ice cream carts and toy sellers.Over all must to experience in Colombo.

body: Galle Face Green is hailed by many people. The first time we made our way there but all normal operations were shut down by the military in order to practice for the Independence Day parade. However, the truth of its normal setting is that it’s really just a generally crowded and repetitious set of carts and Sri Lankan street food. My fiancée and I didn’t decide to eat anything because she doesn’t like fried foods and has long been unhappy with Sri Lankan food in general on our 2 week trip. The walk along the beach isn’t anything special, in fact we had many better beach walking experiences in Negombo, Hikkaduwa, and Mirissa. However, we did come across a man walking a monkey and he brought us up to the sidewalk near the street to hold the monkey, see a snake charming show, and hold a python. It cost me 3,000 rupees, but it was an unforgettable experience.
title: Underwhelming, but with a little surprise

body: Fantastic food and great atmosphere. Loved seeing the children and adults flying their kites and enjoying their evening meal.

Local families out for the afternoon and evening jostle with tourists, food vendors and other stall holders ina happy mix. Although the sea is not safe to swim in, there are always people on the beach itself. Not too hot for a walk by late afternoon/early evening.

body: Interesting promenade by the sea and a glimpse into the use the area is put to by families and couples out for a walk, a splash, a snack or flying exotic kites. As an accessible sea- side location it is fun to walk and watch while enjoying a cold drink and munching on a peculiar but tasty shrimp on a toasted cookie-cracker.
title: Strolling the sandy green

body: Such a great area for a relaxing stroll! In fact, you may even go around taking in the beautiful sights and the people enjoying themselves. There are street vendors all over the place who are extremely friendly and sell the best and cheapest food! I love it!
title: Great area for a relaxing.

body: What a lovely place to walk of a late afternoon or early evening. Lots of people enjoying the sun, fresh air and sea views. Full of colour, kites, kids, and food - it's a great place to see the locals and experience the Sri Lankan culture.
title: Galle Face Green

body: It was not too crowded and a lovely place too walk in the evening. A few food vendors which i avoided due to lack of hygiene. Rest, its a beautiful walk.
title: Loved walking there

body: Beach front with wide drive way. Good place to unwind after a day of work.Beauty broken by large construction projects of the port - city.
title: Beach front

body: Nice walk along the foreshore where many Sri Lankan families and teenagers gather. Probably a nice spot to grab a cheap meal if you are interested.
title: Not too green

body: Galle face green is a famous local hotspot in Colombo, just south of fort, where lots of locals come to meet, socialise, eat and watch the sunset. We headed up on a poya day and it was pretty busy but not as busy as we expected. It's certainly a family-friendly place - there are lots of stalls selling toys and there were lots of kids flying kites. Sadly, as vegetarians, the food stalls were very disappointing - there's lots of them, but they're all pretty much the same, and it was mostly meat and fish. Still, the atmosphere was good, and it's a good focal point to see the intense development that's happening around this end of Colombo - huge tower block hotels are being built all round, it'll be a very different place in a few years time, so enjoy it while you still can!
title: Interesting local place for sunset

body: We walked from the Old Dutch Hospital to the Galle Face Hotel at 11:30 am on a Sunday. Armed with bottles of water, sunscreen and wide brimmed hats, we strolled along the "promenade" which on that day was sunny, with barely a breeze. Vendors were beginning to set up their stands within "smelling distance" of rotting trash.We enjoyed watching kids trying to fly kites, families walking along the rocky, uneven "beach" and parents trying to trying to appease their kids when the ice cream cones they purchased immediately started melting. Granted, this area would have been more interesting in the late afternoon when there is more activity and the temperatures more bearable. I was disappointed because I had envisioned a shady tree-lined, grass-covered promenade with a wide sandy beach.
title: A bit disappointing, but still worth checking out.

body: Spectacular place in Asia to relax . Food and transport very cheap.Plenty of Public transport and Tuk Tuk available. Some banks and restaurants are open 24/7.
title: Colombo

body: Its a Good and easy access street food market. No need for dinner that evening. THE kids had alot of rotti and fruits so pleanty for all the family
title: Nice evening walk with amazing street food

body: There is no shade anywhere to sit down and relax. I would have expected some cover.The sea area is littered with glass, bottles, etc. Do not walk barefoot here as it is not safe.Lots of street side vendors selling drinks and food.I went during the day, sure night would be a different experience.
title: Dirty beach and no shade

body: This is a beach front in the city centre .A good place to go for a walk in the morning or evenings. Lots of street food outlets in the late evening.
title: Beach Front

body: Galle Face Green is a beach side area full of activities. body: To me, this is such a cheerful and special place. It’s perfect to have a romantic picnic with your partner, to have fun with your family or even to hang out with your friends. The food is quite good, but the best part is the view at night. It’s so beautiful and always crowded with people having fun! Definitely would recommend!
title: Definitely would recommend!

body: The Galle Face Green is famous but our visit had little green, just heavily trodden clay perhaps from the holiday celebrations. The heavy construction and land reclamation on seafront has destroyed the view. The charm of the Galle Face is gone. Nearby however at the maritime museum is the elevated stupa which provides wonderful view of the harbor if you climb the stairs-no fee.
title: Lost luster

body: We stayed for 4 days here. The area is something to enjoy and embrace the history. We enjoyed a umber of walks around and through this the Fort. The sunsets are simply amazing and also its great to see locals and or visitors exercising or playing a bit of cricket. The loclal restaurants are in my view pretty good and we generally ate within the complex. There wer also some nightly entertainment in the open areas etc.Both my wife and I got to meet some of the locals and enjoyed our time, we were somewhat saddened to leave on our next part of our journey.
title: Galle and Fort Complex.

body: The area is incredible. Big buildings are rising, on one side os the road. Ocean on the other one. Perfect for a walk

title: Waterfront with no beach

body: I was in a group of 10 & not one of us saw the worth here. Such a waste of time. It's dirty & stinky. There is no food that I would actually eat here. We ended up waiting back to our Hotel to eat. I felt bad I recommended this to my friends after reading reviews.

body: After two weeks of kind Sri Lankan people this is the only place that scammed us trough our whole journey. A guy with a smooth talk first talks you in and tells you to choose a nice mix from the showcases and if you want some beers, which are not on the menu. (Normally we ask the price before ordering but after two weeks of unnecessary suspicion we lost our edge a bit).After we finished our meal he presented us an insane bill of over 10.000 rs ($50) including Lion beers for 1100 rs ($6) each and a chicken leg for 1500 rs ($7,50). So we had a long and heated discussion with the guy and talked some off the price but still payed much more than he deserved. I don't mind paying a bit more because I'm a tourist but this was really insane. So watch out when visiting this place! The other smaller streetfood stands sell very nice shrimpcookie things and other nice local snacks though.
title: Avoid yellow tent on north side (scam)

body: The Galle Face is an excellent place for a morning walk or a workout. The fresh air, the gentle purr to the great roar of the waters & the waves all make for a refreshing morning. It is good for an evening stroll too. Clean and well maintained!

body: A sparse area of grass overlooking the sea, populated with some street food vendors, selling some magnificent fair. However, we nearly fell vicitm to a rouge tuk tuk driver and his tout. We left the front of our hotel and walked towards Fort, and a chap started talking to us. He said do you remember me from Shangri-la, I saw you this morning. I didn't, however with the curse of English incesent politeness, my wife said she did (later admitted she did not) . He offered to show us the way to the local temple, only to state shortly in to the trip that we should take a tuk tuk as there may be some protest today. He summoned a tuk tuk and off we went, leaving him waving us off. Having travelled extensively, experience told me to obtain a price for this first, only to be told that the price was on the meter - suspiciously there was no meter present. In fairness the tour was very good, the temple beautiful and the driver gave us some good information. We were taken back to the hotel, however then came the fun part. The driver stopped us equidistant and therefore as far as was reasonably possible from the hotel entrance and promptly demanded 6500lkr for what was a 10 minute each way journey. He was firmly rebuffed however was persistent in return. We then trudged away from him having refused to hand any cash over at all. Arriving at the Shangri La security Post we spoke with the guard, whose eyes bulged at the demanded price. As soon as the captain of the tuk tuk saw we were in conversation with the guard, the price miraculously changed from 6500 to 650. Weird as I had confirmed the demand of 6500 with captain tuk tuk three times on my phones calculator. Little sod. Needless to say, beware of these shiesters and stand your ground!!
title: A little sparse with dodgy tuk tuks

body: There is a huge land reclamation going on with construction cranes everywhere.The area is windy but not well maintained. Good place to enjoy the evening breeze and setting sun. Food stalls at the location does not look appetising
title: Marred by new developments

body: This is a place of fun and amusement! It is situated at the heart of Colombo, just infront of the presidential secretariat (The old parliament) and iconic hotels such as Shangri La and Galle face hotel. This is the place of choice for large gatherings and political meetings. On other days, it is full of people, families who want to enjoy their evenings.Definitely a relaxing place for families to rejoice and get rid of the day's stress. Ideal place to take children. They can enjoy toys around, kites and yummy bites. There are famous fast food shops known as Naana shops, that offer lots of fast food. Have been here many times. This time visited alone, just for a walk in morning. You can also see the development of the Colombo Port City which is very closeby. The sea is very rough, dangerous and deep. So never step into it. There are more to enjoy on the beach other than that!
title: Hot spot of Colombo evenings and nights!

body: When we arrived in Colombo we managed to time it almost perfectly to coincide with what ended up being the largest political rally ever staged in Sri Lanka. The entire green was packed with men and women celebrating/protesting the constitutional crisis of recent weeks. It was some event and we were close witnesses.The next day when we walked the entire length it had returned to normal: children dipping into the Indian Ocean, stalls of street food, kites flying and couples courting. A place to see Colombo relaxing...
title: A political platform

body: This place continues to hold its charm over so many years as far as I can remember.... You can expect a whole array of people from ones just relaxing, people jogging and exercising, kids playing around and numerous street vendors.....However, I wonder how long the place would hold its charm in the future when the Port City comes into operation as it would take away the view and possible sea erosion due to change of wave patterns.....But that's something to worry in the future and you should make a visit to this charming place, but be aware of the ants roaming the entire area, if you are with little kids..... Also it would be better to avoid visiting this place during daytime as the scorching sun would take away all the fun....
title: Great place for a relaxing evening

body: This has been a Colombo icon for 60 years that I know of. You can get a good kite for about $4 AU there are 100’s to choose from , enough room to fly a kite and then go the Galle Face Hotel for afternoon tea, nice cool breeze on a hot day as well.

title: Lovely to see the locals promenading and playing cricket

title: EVENING MOON WALK

body: Its a nice place tospend the evening in Colombo with lots pf people around and cool breeze from sea embraces you. There are small hawkers selling sea foods down the lane which is pretty inexpensive. A tuktuk can take you there even if you stay in a corner of Colombo. Sunday is a rush hour but you enjoy the crowd.
title: Good place in Colombo

body: After drinks at the Kingsbury's rooftop bar, we were heading for the Galle Face Hotel for another drink. Our host asked if we wanted to take a tuk tuk or walk. No brainer! Of course we wanted to walk and we didn't even know that would mean a stroll down Galle Face Green. What a great bustling place it is. I'm reminded of Mumbai's Marine Drive or Zanzibar's Stone Town sea-front food market. Dozens of small stalls selling the kind of food that looks great, probably tastes great, but is a bit of a risk when you're new in town and don't want to risk food poisoning from a Crab Cake that's been sitting in the sun all afternoon. We walked on a blustery afternoon, enjoying the crowds, watching families at play, couples a-courting, and Colombo's locals having fun to one side and the ocean crashing in on the other. Loved it!
title: A sunset stroll

body: It is a stretch of about 500 meters along the sea on one side and star class hotels surrounding the area, northern end is Kingsbury Hotel and southern end is famous Galle face hotel with colonial architecture.Friday to Sunday is busy and crowded with locals visiting this place. So Monday to Thursday is highly recommended for a peaceful visit.There are about 200m of stalls selling food and drink of various types so no one need go hungry. Also it is a great place for flying kites and a great number were in evidence.Watching the Sunset is great. So if interested visit around 5-7p.m. After 8 p.m. it is not recommended for a tourist to hang around although tourist police is present.
title: Advice for Foreigners

body: The view of the sea is good as the ramp takes you into the ocean. But on a Sunday or Holiday the beach is very crowded. If you like adventure you can go down to the rocks, but the sea is very rough out there. There are several stalls selling various food, the most popular are the Prawn Cakes and the Crab Cakes. Nice place to spend some leisure time watching the sea.

body: A good place for spending time with friends. There are some famous hotels there. You will find mobile food shops there.

body: They called it Galle face Green... Now u can't see the grass. crowded with locals specially on weekends (Fri/Sat & sun). Good for morning jogging, walking & for running. U get fresh Air. There will be more new hotels coming up around Galle Face...

body: On my way to an evening of socializing I spent yday a little bit of quality time enjoying the beauty and wonder of nature yday. body: Great little food stalls, snake charmer, school children playing, kites flying and lots of locals enjoying this area. A really great atmosphere.

body: I had been advised that it was perfectly safe to walk alone in the middle of the day along the front here, & it was BUT I could have done without being approached several times by young local men trying to engage in conversation, suggesting I go with them (I am seriously middle aged!). body: Galleface green is one of the most attractive beach front place in Colombo.. Surrounded by class hotels and restaurants.. We had a great time.. It was a Saturday evening and full of people.. More entertaining for kids.. Kids loves to send kites.. Road side food was yummy.

body: I was staying at a hotel close to the Galle face, so I thought if going for a sea side walk at late evening. It's a secluded place on weekdays so not advisable to visit alone. On weekends or early evening on weekdays however, it's a nice place to visit

body: I have stayed three times at the Galle Face Hotel next to the Green, which sadly isn't green at all these days. It is nice to take a stroll there next to the water to watch the families and kite flying. It has been 7 years since my first visit and I have to express my disappointment at how dirty it has become. Garbage strewn around everywhere. If you are staying close by then do take a stroll there, but don't make a special effort. There is a huge amount of development going on in the area.
title: Visit if you are nearby.

body: A lovely place for a long walk by the beach, the view of the port and buildings around are quite good. The sound of the sea and watching the waves hit the shore is very soothing. we were there for quite a long time and with a bunch of friends it is even more fun.

body: If in Colombo you should find time to visit, it's just vibrant with lots of kids flying kites and people enjoying themselves.We purchased street food which was tasty and at a reasonable price.

body: We went this evening after a LONG day of travelling in from England. Saw a street food stall that was very busy with locals - we had a look and the staff were very friendly and explained the menu well. They offered us tastes of the food and I tried to order. He was offering us so much food and we asked for rice, calamari, a sausage and a cheese naan. He then offered us some noodle thing and I said “can we have half noodle half rice”. He said yes. We stupidly didn’t ask the price. He then brought us 2 x rice dishes, 1 x noodle, 2 x sausages, 1 x calamari and 2 x beers. We presumed they were being very friendly and this was just the portion sizes. Despite being more food then we could ever eat we laughed it off and said “oh well it’s street food - how much can it really cost”... 8,900 rupees which is £40!!!! He brought the menu over and talked through it exactly and added it up in front of us. I said no that is too expensive - you’ve shown us the wrong prices. But the owners wouldn’t budge and we left feeling ripped off for mediocre food. Other than that the beach is a state - the only nice thing is that there are lots of kites being flown which is pretty - we would of bought one and had a go but we were too wounded by the over pricing.
title: AVOID STREET FOOD MASSIVE SCAM

body: Galle Face Green is a favorite place for Sri Lankans and tourists to take a casual walk along the shore of the Indian Ocean in the evening. There is much to see. There are street food sellers, children paying with kites, and some places to put your feet in the water. The area is easily reached by tuk tuk.Galle Face Green is the flanked by some of the most famous colonial buildings in Sri Lanka, good restaurants, and the old parliament buildings. Personally, the best thing for me are the wonderfully refreshing sea-breezes that blow new life into one after a hot day in the sun.Most definitely a family place, nice open spaces for runners and exercise freaks and totally safe. Go there to meet Sri Lankans and experience the inner child in you by flying a kite,

body: The Green is used as a promenade for a stroll along the edge of a long sea wall.It has a lawn area for sitting ,eating relaxing.At night it is full of family,couples and friends enjoying one and others company. body: Access :Galle face if located at the commercial center of Colombo , the capital city of Sri Lanka. It is a Large Green area resided next to the Sea. It is within 1.5Km from Colombo main Bus Stand / railway station (Pettah ) and just next to many famous star hotels including Shangri la , Ramada , Taj Samudra , Galadhari , The Kingsbury , Hilton and Ancient Galle Face Hotel too. There is no entry fee to this location and ample parking available nearby. From Pettah a tuk-tuk will charge you Rs.150 - 200 to drop at Galle Face.Location : The sea at Galle face is calm nice beach area , next to colombo harbour .You will find that many people, children play at the beach and having bath and enjoy. This place is very beautiful during evenings and you will experience amazing sunsets here ( Please see the photos I shared )This green is very famous for Kiting and everyday you can see kids and elders enjoy kiting . There are many food stalls along the cost and you will find spicy Sri Lankan ,Indian, Malaysian and Chinese food stalls whew you can have a good meal at a price around 5$. Consuming alcohol in public places is not allowed in Sri Lanka and the same rule applies here.There is no special restrictions or risks in this are and there are many Police officers and Guards in this are till mid night. Normally you can visit this place from morning to night x 365 days (Except for very few days where there are some special celebrations happens here - Ex. National Independence day) .
title: Galle Face - Relaxing are in the center of the capital city - Colombo

title: No longer Galle Face Green

body: The Galle face green that I know was green and clean. But now with economic development and the Port city emerging out of the blues: it has killed the enthusiasm of going and relaxing at galle face. yet the street snacks especially the "prawn vadai" still sells fast.The cool breeze and space for an evening stroll until late night is still possible.The area is shrinking fast and with many hotels coming up on the border of the galle road can bring many more changes. God save the Galle face green!

body: For a pleasant meander in the evenings with the warm sea breeze in your face, this well located 'green' has seen better days.The 'Green' is now a dust hole,with litter everywhere.The cheap food stalls are tawdry,with stale dried up offerings.A little more attention by the Municipal Authorities could turn this area into an oasisof comfort and recreation for the tired masses of Colombo.By planting more robust fescues(grass) to withstand heavy footfalls,the 'Green'could be restored to its former glory!

title: Stunning views of the Indian Ocean
body: Day or night, a walk along the Galle Face Green is always an enjoyable experience.With stunning views of the Indian Ocean, one can also sit there and watch the big ships sail by. title: Happening Place, Must Visit Place in Sri Lanka
body: This is a Very happening place, Lot of ways to spend the time. You can buy a Kite and fly kites. Ideal time is evening. You can see the Sun Set. If you are a Traveler / Tourist / Foreigner Dont miss Galle Face Green. Spend 1 or 2 hours there and you can get an idea about Sri Lankan people and culture.Sun Setting, Indian Ocean, Jogging, Relaxing, Bathing, Photographing, Street Foods, Family, Lovers and Many More things..Children can play. Huge crowds in weekends and holidays. Bathing / Swimming Dangerous. Ample parking space. There are lot of Foods and Street Foods including "Isso Wade" and "Roti". Dont forget to enjoy "NANA" Street Food restaurant

title: Yummy Food street
body: This tasty prawn vadai is from Sri Lanka. This is a simple snack dish that relies on the best quality small, firm prawns you can find. The aroma of the mouth-watering fried prawn vadai is wonderful. Serve this prawn vadai with a dab of lime juice or chopped onions.
